choice.basis: The dashboard 'Product Rating Share by Category' shows the current labeled rating shares as the percentage inscriptions directly above each category mark: Design 52%, Support 45%, Delivery 39%, Other 32%, Quality 24%, Price 10%. Comparing these labeled values, Design has the highest current labeled rating share (52% > 45% > 39% > 32% > 24% > 10%). The follow-up rule is to select the category with the highest current labeled rating share, so the corresponding available option is Design.
